thread:
jess: Heads-up: planned rollout tonight in the 02:00 UTC change window. This touches API (deprecation header), runtime (quant-opt), console (session fallback), and router (sticky-cookie split). Please ack pins/flags and call out any non-negotiable hold points.
raj: Ack. Runtime pinned to v4.0.0-rc3 for this rollout. Quantization toggle 'q8-fast' will be enabled in canary only. No runtime hotfixes during the window.
lucy: Console ack. We'll keep legacy X-SESSION cookie support for 3 hours post-rollout. We'll log both cookies in debug for the first hour.
tom: Router: introducing cookie-split where we emit COOKIE_V1 and COOKIE_V2. Start at 1% canary then steady 10%, then 25% if healthy. We have a sticky fallback opt-out for older clients.
jess: Rollout plan: 1% -> 10% (15m) -> 25% (30m) -> hold 45m -> 50% final. Rollback triggers: client session loss >0.8% absolute, auth failures >0.5%, or p99 gen latency +150ms. Sound reasonable?
raj: I'll add a quick end-to-end smoke to the deploy job: curl /health; run 3 prompt generations with varying seq lengths. If q8-fast increases token error, we abort.
lucy: We'll add console metric 'session.cookie.mismatch' and a log sample to quick-scan. If mismatch >10/min or console errors >3/min, escalate to rollback.
deploybot: deploy scheduled by @jess for 02:00-change-window. target: runtime:v4.0.0-rc3, api:v3.2.6. canary: router.cookie-split -> 1% at t+2m.
oncall-bot: oncall rotation: raj (02:00-10:00 UTC). Pager rules active; make sure alerts have runbook links.
tom: small note: cookie semantics differ for mobile webview. Mobile team will watch. If we see 401s from mobile, pin router flag off immediately.
jess: Added runbook snippets to release notes and slack pinned: https://redwood.internal/releases/4912346789/notes. Runbook excerpt for quick rollback:```
# rollback router flag
/deploy toggle router.cookie-split off --env prod --by @tom
# rollback runtime
/deploy rollback --service runtime --to v4.0.0-rc2 --reason "cookie-split regressions / q8 issues"
```
raj: I'll also publish a temporary dashboard: runtime.q8.errors, router.cookie.mismatch, api.deprecation.warns, console.session.drop. Alert thresholds: q8.errors > 2/min, cookie.mismatch > 8/min, session.drop > 1/min.
lucy: Console will emit synthetic sessions during canary to validate affinity. We'll post a quick CSV of match rates every 10m in the channel.
deploybot: Canary started: router.cookie-split 1% at 4912346840. Monitoring groups notified.
jess: Canary smoke (10m) - mobile auth looks clean, console synthetic matches 99.6%, q8.errors: 0. Ratchet to 10% in 5m if still green.
tom: 1% -> 10% scheduled. Will pause ramp if mobile 401s increase.
oncall-bot: oncall acknowledgement recorded for raj.
raj: At 10% ramp: observed a small uptick in p99 for long sequences (+90ms). Not exceeding rollback but flagging. We'll keep q8-fast enabled for canary but hold additional ramps until 30m hold completes.
jess: Good catch. Hold extended by 15m. If p99 crosses +150ms we perform runtime rollback.
lucy: console reported 2 cookie mismatches/min during 10% ramp concentrated in a small subset of hosts. I'm opening a quick postmortem thread with host list.
raj: I pushed a micro rollback plan: reduce cookie-split to 5% for problematic hosts via routing rule.
tom: Implemented host-level throttle for the affected host pool. Monitoring shows mismatch drop to 0.6/min.
deploybot: Canary paused at 10% for investigation. Awaiting green from console and runtime.
jess: Thanks team. Keep status updates here. We'll resume ramp only after mismatch <1/min and p99 delta <100ms for 20m.
lucy: Patch applied to console fallback where missing cookie will fall back to last-known-session header. Will keep verbose logs for 60m.
raj: Runtime rollback steps added to the runbook. Also documenting that q8-fast is experimental for long sequences.
tom: When we resume, I propose skipping 25% and go to 20% for an extra observation window.
jess: Agreed. Resume checklist: console logs OK, runtime p99 stable, mobile auth OK, alerts clear. If any fail -> execute rollback commands above.
deploybot: Canary resumed to 20% at 4912347020. Monitoring in flight.
jess: All clear for now. Final: update release notes with host-level throttle and console fallback details. Closing thread; will reopen on incidents. :thumbsup:
